classData.comment:
/**
 * @summary Moves through the steps of the account form. Next validates the open step, Create account validates every
 * step and submits the whole form, and the step list moves freely.
 * @class Form.view.ViewportController
 * @extends Neo.controller.Component
 */
classData.summary:
Moves through the steps of the account form. Next validates the open step, Create account validates every
step and submits the whole form, and the step list moves freely.
classData.name: ViewportController

classData.comment:
/**
     * @summary Validates every step in order. The first invalid one opens and says what is wrong; with none, the
     * review step shows the submitted values. They go to the review step itself: a state provider would split the
     * object into one data path per leaf.
     * @param {Object} data
     */
classData.summary:
Validates every step in order. The first invalid one opens and says what is wrong; with none, the
review step shows the submitted values. They go to the review step itself: a state provider would split the
object into one data path per leaf.
classData.name: onCreateAccountButtonClick

classData.comment:
/**
     * @summary An edit makes the last check stale: the edited step loses its valid mark until Next or Create account
     * checks it again, and the review step shows the open form instead of the object Create account submitted.
     * @param {Object} data
     * @param {Neo.form.field.Base} data.component The edited field
     */
classData.summary:
An edit makes the last check stale: the edited step loses its valid mark until Next or Create account
checks it again, and the review step shows the open form instead of the object Create account submitted.
classData.name: onFieldUserChange

classData.comment:
/**
     * @summary Unfolds the step list above the form on a phone, or folds it away again.
     * @param {Object} data
     */
classData.summary: Unfolds the step list above the form on a phone, or folds it away again.
classData.name: onStepsButtonClick

classData.comment:
/**
     * @summary Opens a step, clears the message of the step before, and folds a phone's step list away.
     * @param {Number} index
     * @param {String|null} [stepMessage=null]
     */
classData.summary: Opens a step, clears the message of the step before, and folds a phone's step list away.
classData.name: showStep

classData.summary:
Validates one step and marks it in the step list. An invalid step opens and names its invalid fields:
a checkbox or radio group by the label of its first item.
classData.name: validateStep
